rooms.description: A rib of pale metal hangs above the world. The yellow sun is a hard white disc without air to soften it; Charge pours in faster than any street bask. The ground curves away below. Type 'descend' to fall back to your last open-sky footing.
rooms.title: Low Orbit Platform

rooms.description: Heat without sound. The corona washes this ledge in radiation that would kill anything without a Solar Charge battery. West returns to the Low Orbit Platform; there is no further ascent -- this is the premium soak, not a dungeon.
rooms.title: Stellar Corona Edge
